case.en: Lian Li L207 mesh front panel, placed 10 mm in front of the fan intake to simulate case resistance.
case.zh-Hans: 联力 L207 机箱网孔前面板，置于风扇进风面前方，间距 10 mm，模拟机箱安装阻抗。

heatsink.en: One Noctua NH-D15 heatsink tower, placed behind the fan exhaust to simulate an air-cooling heatsink.
heatsink.zh-Hans: 猫头鹰 NH-D15 单侧塔体，置于风扇出风面后方，模拟风冷散热器阻抗。

radiator.en: A standard 120/140 radiator, 27 mm thick, placed behind the fan exhaust to simulate a liquid-cooling radiator.
radiator.zh-Hans: 27 mm 厚的标准 120/140 冷排，置于风扇出风面后方，模拟水冷散热器阻抗。
